metadata.title: Tarte Au Chocolat (Chocolate Tart) recipe - Valentine's Day Special! - CookingWithAlia - Episode 229
metadata.description:
How to make Chocolate Tart a to-die-for dessert that is very easy to make! This can be an ideal dessert for a Valentine's Day dinner! You can either purchase the dough already made from the store or make it yourself (check out my recipe on how to make Pate Sucree).

Written recipe: http://www.cookingwithalia.com/index.php?option=com_zoo&task=item&item_id=240&Itemid=110

Ingredients:
5 oz (150 grams) good quality dark chocolate (at least 60% cocoa)
1/2 cup (118 ml) of heavy cream
4 tablespoons of milk
1 tablespoon (14 grams) butter
2 large eggs

nodes.plm_action: Prepare the pie crusts.
nodes.plm_caption:
The video features an instructional cooking tutorial presented by a female indoors. It is shot with high quality and has many cuts, and the focus is mainly on the cooking process. The chef shows viewers how to cut the chocolate, melt the chocolate, make chocolate sauce and fill the cupcake molds. She also bakes the chocolate sauce in the oven and finally takes it out when done, cuts the slices and offers them on a white plate. There is a kitchen counter with modern appliances, wooden cabinetry, and some kitchen items in the background.

The video is not very informative, but more a visually appealing and engaging advertisement for the chocolate sauce. It is very easy to follow along, and the camera is of high quality. The use of music helps with the viewing experience and makes it even more visually appealing. Overall the video is a good example of a visually engaging and informative cooking tutorial.

summary.brief: Alia prepares, bakes, and serves a chocolate tart.
summary.detailed: The video opens with Alia introducing a Valentine’s Day chocolate tart, then she chops a block of dark chocolate, heats heavy cream, milk and butter together in a saucepan until boiling, pours the hot cream mixture over the chopped chocolate and stirs until smooth, lets the mixture rest briefly, whisk‑beats eggs into the chocolate mixture until it thickens, pours the filling into a pre‑made tart crust that has been pricked with small holes, places the filled tart in a pre‑heated oven that is then turned off so the residual heat bakes the tart for about fifteen minutes, removes it, lets it cool on the counter and then chills it in the refrigerator for a few hours, finally she slices the set tart into small pieces, shows the creamy interior and crisp crust, tastes a piece, and ends with a close‑up of the sliced tart on a white plate accompanied by on‑screen website and social‑media text.

action.detailed: Chop the chocolate, heat the cream, milk and butter to a boil, pour the hot cream over the chocolate and stir until smooth, whisk in the eggs until the mixture thickens, fill the prepared crust with the chocolate filling, place the tart in a pre‑heated oven then turn the oven off to bake with residual heat, cool on the counter, refrigerate until set, slice the tart and serve the pieces.

nodes.plm_caption:
This video features a woman chipping chocolate pieces with a knife before melting it in a saucepan over a stovetop. The person pours milk and chocolate into a bowl, stirs the mixture before combining it with a bowl of egg yolks. Once the chocolate mixture reaches the desired consistency it is poured into a muffin tin.
The individual behind the counter is wearing a patterned blouse with her hair tied back with a red flower clip, which is also visible in the title shot. There are also some shot glasses visible in the left corner. The setting is indoors.

summary.brief: Alia chops dark chocolate, melts it with cream, milk and butter, incorporates egg yolks, blends in a white powdery ingredient, and pours the smooth filling into a prepared tart crust.
summary.detailed: The video opens with Alia, wearing a patterned blouse and a red flower clip, standing at her kitchen counter. She takes a block of dark chocolate and chops it into small pieces with a knife. In a saucepan she combines heavy cream, milk and butter, heats the mixture on the stove until it begins to boil, and then pours the hot liquid over the chopped chocolate, letting it sit briefly before stirring vigorously until a glossy ganache forms. She adds egg yolks to the ganache and whiskes the mixture until it thickens. In a separate glass bowl she mixes a white, powdery ingredient (likely sugar) into the chocolate‑egg mixture with a spatula and whisk, creating a uniform batter. Finally she pours this chocolate filling evenly into a prepared tart crust that sits in a muffin‑tin‑style pan, smoothing the top in preparation for baking.

action.detailed: Chop dark chocolate, heat cream, milk and butter together, pour the hot mixture over the chocolate and stir to a smooth ganache, whisk in egg yolks until thick, blend in the dry ingredient, and pour the resulting filling into the tart crust.
action.actor: Alia, the female presenter wearing a patterned blouse with a red flower hair clip

summary.detailed: The segment begins with Alia arranging several blue tart tins on a foil‑lined tray. Using a ladle or spoon she pours dark chocolate batter into each tin, tapping the tray to settle the filling. She slides the tray into a pre‑heated oven, where the door closes automatically and the tarts bake. After the baking time she removes the hot tray, sets it on the counter to cool briefly, and then cuts each tart into small wedges or halves with a knife. Close‑up shots show the sliced pieces, and Alia lifts a piece to the camera and eats it while smiling. The segment ends with a still of a chocolate tart on a white plate accompanied by on‑screen text displaying her website and Facebook page, followed by a fade to black.

summary.brief: Alia greets viewers, introduces a Valentine’s Day chocolate tart, chops dark chocolate and mixes it with hot cream, milk and butter to form a smooth filling.
summary.detailed: The segment opens with a close‑up of a sliced chocolate tart on a white plate while the title “Chocolate Tart” appears. Alia, wearing a black‑and‑white floral blouse with a red flower clip, faces the camera, shrugs her shoulders, waves her arms and introduces the Valentine’s Day tart tutorial. She gathers a block of dark chocolate, piles it on a cutting board and chops it into small pieces with a chef’s knife. She then places a saucepan on the stove, adds heavy cream, milk and butter, and heats the mixture on medium until it nearly boils. While the liquid is hot, she pours it over the chopped chocolate and lets the mixture rest for about a minute. She gently whiskes the combination in a mixing bowl until it becomes glossy and smooth. During this time she also preheats the oven to around 170 °C (350 °F). The segment ends with a close‑up of the right side of the kitchen, showing the countertop, cabinets, a microwave and a refrigerator.

action.detailed: Chop the chocolate into small pieces, heat the cream, milk and butter together, pour the hot liquid over the chocolate, and whisk until the mixture is smooth and glossy.

summary_sent_to_llm.description:
How to make Chocolate Tart a to-die-for dessert that is very easy to make! This can be an ideal dessert for a Valentine's Day dinner! You can either purchase the dough already made from the store or make it yourself (check out my recipe on how to make Pate Sucree).

Written recipe: http://www.cookingwithalia.com/index.php?option=com_zoo&task=item&item_id=240&Itemid=110

Ingredients:
5 oz (150 grams) good quality dark chocolate (at least 60% cocoa)
1/2 cup (118 ml) of heavy cream
4 tablespoons of milk
1 tablespoon (14 grams) butter
2 large eggs
